title: Decision: out-of-band deletion of stored messages must be handled cleanly
description: Mark, 2026-11-21. An operator may delete old messages directly in the database (sqlite3 CLI), with the server running or stopped, in any amount and order, not necessarily a clean prefix. Nothing may panic, return serverFail, wedge a room or corrupt state. Message/changes from a state whose rows are gone returns cannotCalculateChanges (or the correct changes); Message/get of a gone id lists it in notFound; Message/query with a gone anchor returns anchorNotFound; a stream Subscribe from a gone position returns cannotResume. Fanout, outbox and hub processing keep working. The agent that missed Commits rejoins by external Commit where room policy allows, otherwise reports a Problem and marks the room as needing a re-invite; missed application messages are shown as one notice in the room. Implemented under mimid-e64f.19.
